slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize the total profit from the three products?
slot_scores.rationale: Agent explicitly asked about the objective and whether to maximize profit, directly addressing the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved in turn 1, but the agent repeatedly asked the same integrality question (turns 2, 9, 11, 13, 14) despite the user indicating it needed internal confirmation, which is low-value repetition.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the core objective (H1) but then engaged in repetitive questioning about integrality, leading to an over-questioning pattern before finally assuming continuous variables.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
